scheme_name: Organizing Block Demonstration Through Department And Also Through TNAU
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Tamil Nadu

Must grow maize in the following districts: Coimbatore, Dindigul, Erode, Dharmapuri, Krishnagiri, Namakkal, Perambalur, Virudhunagar, Theni, Villupuram, Vellore, Salem, Pudukkottai, Madurai, Sivagangai, Trichy, Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi
Special focus on small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹4,000 per 1‑hectare maize demonstration plot.
